content: आदित्य {%a.%} [अदितेरपत्यं ण्य <ls>P. IV. 1. 85.</ls>] .²1 Solar, belonging to, or born in, the solar line; आदित्यैर्यदि विग्रहो नृपतिभिर्धन्यं ममैतत्ततो <ls>U. 6. 18</ls>. .²2 Devoted to, or originating from, Aditi आदित्यं चरुं निर्वपेत् <ls>Yaj. Ts. 2. 2. 6. 1</ls>. .²3 Belonging to, or sprung from, the Ādityas. .{@-त्यः@} .²1 A son of Aditi; a god, divinity in general. [The number of Ādityas appears to have been originally seven, of whom Varuṇa is the head, and the name Āditya was restricted to them, देवा आदित्या ये सप्त <ls>Rv. 9. 114. 3</ls>. In the time of the Brāhmaṇas, however, the number of Ādityas rose to 12, representing the sun in the 12 months of the year; धाता मित्रोऽर्यमा रुद्रो वरुणः सूर्य एव च . भगो विवस्वान् पूषा च सविता दशमः स्मृतः .. एकादशस्तथा त्वष्टा विष्णुर्द्वादश उच्यते .]; आदित्यानामहं विष्णुः <ls>Bg. 10. 21</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 24</ls>. (These 12 suns are supposed to shine only at the destruction of the universe; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ve. 3. 8</ls>; दग्धुं विश्वं दहनकिरणैर्नोदिता द्वादशार्काः). .²2 The sun; <ls>Vāj. 4. 21</ls>. .²3 A name of Viṣṇu in his fifth or dwarf-incarnation; स्वयंभूः शंभुरादित्यः <ls>V. Sah.</ls> .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the {%Arka%} plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>रुई</ns>). .{@-त्यौ@} (dual) <ab>N.</ab> of a constellation, the seventh lunar mansion (पुनर्वसु).
